concepts.name: Geographical Location And Economic Devel
concepts.simple_definition: Geographical location and economic development Heavy and perishable crops (vegetables, fruits & dairy products) are suggested to be produced nearer to the city in the model
concepts.deep_explanation: Bulky products (firewood & timber) are supposed to cover the next zone for they demand higher transport costs if produced further from the city market
